critical_risk_assessment.alert: 機能要件は満たしていますが、以下の設計判断は高負荷時または実運用においてデータ欠損を引き起こす可能性があります。

findings.issue: 最新フラグメントの欠損 (Queue Full Strategy)
findings.description: Ingestキューが満杯の際、`try_send` エラーで「送信しようとした最新の入力」を破棄しています。ユーザーが入力を完了した瞬間の「最も重要な確定テキスト」が、直前の推論遅延により捨てられるリスクが高いです。
findings.recommendation: 現在の「新規破棄」から「最古破棄（リングバッファ）」または「`tokio::sync::watch`（最新値のみ保持）」への変更を強く推奨します。

findings.issue: 非同期ランタイム内のブロッキングI/O
findings.description: `std::fs::File`, `BufWriter` の使用はTokioのワーカースレッドをブロックし、WebSocketのハートビートや並行処理に悪影響を与えます。
findings.recommendation: `tokio::fs` への置き換え、または `tokio::task::spawn_blocking` でのラップが必要です。

summary.workspace: Rust workspace with 2 crates: `tuff-brg` (middleware/ws) and `tuff-db` (core + lightweight)
summary.goal: LLM hallucination suppression via fast-path fact checks and WAL-based verifiable pipeline

layers: Addon (`tuff-brg/addon`): DOM fragment extraction + WS streaming + throttle
Bridge (`tuff-brg`): WS server, Fast Path(cache), LLM ingest, STOP/CONTINUE control, history API
DB (`tuff-db`): pipeline + WAL engine + lightweight verifier/storage

runtime_flow.fast_path: `LightweightVerifier` checks `tag/payload` first. Hit -> WHITE immediate response. Mismatch -> SMOKE + STOP.
runtime_flow.llm_path: Unknown in cache -> `pipeline.ingest()` with 3s timeout -> JudgeResult + optional STOP.
runtime_flow.history: `/history/api/*` serves static `history_out/*.json` then merges lightweight WAL snapshot at response time.

improvements: Lightweight spec fixed in docs, but protocol doc is still marked Draft; freeze versioning and backward compatibility policy.
`shutdown_signal()` currently calls `std::process::exit(0)`; validate flush guarantees for in-flight writes under stress.
History generation is still offline (`history_compile`); automate trigger policy if runtime freshness is required.
open_questions: TagDB key canonical form is implemented, but ownership of canonicalization (addon/bridge/dbどこで最終確定するか) is not fully explicit.
MeaningDB value semantics: plain snippet vs structured constraints (exact/contains/per-tag rule extension) still limited.
Bridge↔Lightweight integration policy: embedded verifier in-process vs separate lightweight TCP daemon for production.

notes.compat: Current behavior matches AGENTS progress notes (cache-first + watch channel + SIGINT/SIGTERM handling).
notes.risk: If a different TTY process is alive, Ctrl+C perception can appear inconsistent (already noted in AGENTS).
